topics.title: London years and the journey to America

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the narrator's frugal life among Bengali bachelors in London.
Explain why and how the narrator moved to America and what he learnt on the way.

topics.title: First weeks at the YMCA in Cambridge

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how the narrator adjusted to food, noise and routine at the YMCA.
Identify the differences between British and American usage and life that the narrator notices.
Recall the narrator's first visit to Mrs Croft's house and the terms of his stay.
Interpret the details that build up the character of Mrs Croft.

topics.title: Mala and the narrator's family past

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the narrator's arranged marriage to Mala and his early indifference to her.
Explain how the memory of the narrator's mother shapes his response to Mrs Croft.

topics.title: Life in Mrs Croft's house and Helen's visits

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the evening ritual of the flag on the moon builds a bond between the narrator and Mrs Croft.
Analyse Helen's relationship with her mother and what it reveals about Mrs Croft.

topics.title: Mala's arrival and the narrator's reflection

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how Mala and the narrator begin their life together in America.
Explain why the visit to Mrs Croft becomes a turning point in the marriage.
Evaluate the narrator's closing reflection on his ordinary yet remarkable life on three continents.
